titles.title: Inside the Tent While at U. of Virginia

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: The large, dark-colored triangular shape of the tent door occupies the center of this image.  On each side of the door, the tent fabric descends from the upper edge of the work and curves outward toward its edges.  The fabric on the left side is decorated with thick vertical stripes, while the fabric on the right side lacks any pattern.  A reddish-colored object with black stripes lies along the base of the door.  This artwork has *Untitled (Abstraction)*, 1916 (cat. no. 121) on the back.
